ExecutionCopy ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT 29, 2022, between THE KEW-FOREST SCHOOL, INC., a corporation chartered under the Education Law of the State of New York, having an office address at 119-17 Union Turnpike, ForestHills,NewYork11375("Seller"),and 78-29AUSTINSTREET HOLDING LLC,a New Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11224 ("Purchaser"). RECITALS A. Seller is the fee owner of the parcel of land, with the existing building(s) and other improvements thereon, designated as Block 3345, Lot 20 on the Tax Map of The City of New York, Queens County (the “Tax Map"), and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Seller's Parcel,” and said building(s) and other improvements, together with any replacements, renovations and alterations thereof being herein called the “Seller's Building,” and the Seller's Parcel and the Seller's Building being herein called the “Seller's Property"). B. Purchaser is the fee owner of the parcel of land, designated as Block 3345, Lot 1 on the Tax Map, and more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called"Purchaser's Parcel"). C. Purchaser intends to construct one or more new buildings and other improvements associated therewith upon Purchaser's Parcel (such buildings, with any further replacements, renovations and alterations thereof permitted in accordance with the Zoning Resolution(as hereinafter defined) are herein collectively referred to as the“Purchaser's Building:”and the Purchaser's Parcel and the Purchaser's Building, together, the “Purchaser's Property"). D. Seller's Building contains less "floor area," as that term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on Seller's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on thePurchaser'sProperty. E.It is contemplated that Purchaser's Building will contain more “floor area,” as that term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use on the Purchaser's Parcel under the“floor area ratio”limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution,as of the datehereof,if thePurchaser'sParcelwereconsidered anindependentzoninglot,and the partieshereto therefore desire touse the procedure available pursuant to theZoningResolutionfor the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights for use in the construction and maintenance of Purchaser's Building, and Seller is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Purchaser in perpetuity.
